desc: For varmints, this is the end. Our single-shot, bolt-action 110 LRPV delivers exceptional long-range accuracy. Features include user-adjustable AccuTrigger™ technology, an HS Precision fiberglass stock with v-block, fluted full-profile stainless steel barrel, and an oversized bolt handle. It's drilled and tapped for scope mounts and offers right-bolt, left-port operation.
